title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro tops Editorial Craft benchmark with 0.97 score
summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation of 12 AI models, OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Pro ranked first with a 0.97 score at $0.0091 per task. OpenAI claimed four of the top six spots, while Grok 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 tied at 0.93 among the leading non-OpenAI models.
